استهللن (form X)
# اِسْتَهْلَلْنَ (istahlalna) /is.tah.lal.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَهَلَّ (istahalla)
# اُسْتُهْلِلْنَ (ustuhlilna) /us.tuh.lil.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَهَلَّ (istahalla)
# اِسْتَهْلِلْنَ (istahlilna) /is.tah.lil.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَهَلَّ (istahalla)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
